title.zh: 一根线到底能传多少信息
title.en: How Much a Wire Can Carry

desc.zh: 香农算出了一根线、一段空气能传的比特上限，七十年后的编码已经离它不到一分贝。从熵、压缩、噪声信道到汉明码、里德–所罗门、LDPC、极化码、QAM 和多天线，每个算法都在页面里真跑。
desc.en: Shannon computed how many bits a wire or a stretch of air can carry; seventy years on, codes sit within a decibel of that limit. From entropy, compression and noisy channels to Hamming, Reed–Solomon, LDPC, polar codes, QAM and MIMO, every algorithm runs live in the page.

title.zh: 信息量与熵：意外有多少比特
title.en: Surprisal and entropy: how many bits a surprise is worth

desc.zh: 概率为 p 的事件带来 −log₂p 比特；英文每个字母约 1 比特，用猜字游戏和 n 元模型亲手量出来。
desc.en: An event of probability p carries −log₂p bits; English carries about one bit per letter, measured with Shannon's guessing game and n-gram models.

title.zh: 压缩的底：哈夫曼与算术编码
title.en: The floor of compression: Huffman and arithmetic coding

desc.zh: 平均码长不能低于熵；哈夫曼码离熵不到 1 比特，算术编码几乎贴着熵。
desc.en: Average code length cannot beat the entropy; Huffman codes come within one bit, arithmetic coding almost touches it.

desc.zh: 码长等于模型的交叉熵：预测得越准压得越小；随机数据谁也压不了，用计数一证就明。
desc.en: Code length equals the model's cross-entropy, so better prediction means smaller files; random data cannot be compressed, by a counting argument.

zh: 为什么随机数据压不了
en: why random data cannot be compressed

desc.zh: 每个比特以概率 p 翻转时，一次最多可靠传 1 − H(p) 比特；互信息说明了原因。
desc.en: If each bit flips with probability p, at most 1 − H(p) bits per use get through reliably; mutual information says why.

title.zh: 香农–哈特利公式：带宽和信噪比

desc.zh: C = B·log₂(1 + S/N)；拿旅行者号的链路预算算出它从几十亿公里外还能传多快。
desc.en: C = B·log₂(1 + S/N); with the Voyager link budget, how fast it can still send from billions of kilometres away.

title.en: The noisy-channel coding theorem and −1.59 dB

desc.zh: 重复码靠降速换可靠；香农证明不必降到零也能让错误任意少，每比特能量的底是 −1.59 dB。
desc.en: Repetition buys reliability by giving up rate; Shannon proved errors can be made vanishingly rare at a fixed rate, with an energy floor of −1.59 dB per bit.

desc.zh: 三个校验位守住四个数据位，校验子直接写出出错位置。
desc.en: Three parity bits guard four data bits, and the syndrome spells out the position of the error.

desc.zh: 把数据当成有限域上的多项式，多发几个取值点；光盘、二维码靠它扛住划痕和污渍。
desc.en: Treat data as a polynomial over a finite field and send extra evaluations; CDs and QR codes survive scratches and smudges this way.

zh: 二维码为什么脏了还能扫
en: why qr codes still scan when damaged

desc.zh: 稀疏校验加上节点间来回传递的软信息，在页面里实测离香农极限约 2.3 dB。
desc.en: Sparse parity checks plus soft messages passed back and forth; measured in the page at about 2.3 dB from the Shannon limit.

desc.zh: 反复把两条一样的信道合成一好一坏，最后只在好的那批上放数据，第一种被证明能达到容量的构造。
desc.en: Repeatedly turn two identical channels into one better and one worse, then send data only on the good ones: the first construction proven to reach capacity.

title.zh: QAM 调制与自适应编码

desc.zh: 一个符号放 2 到 12 个比特，点越密越怕噪声；手机按信号好坏每毫秒换一次档。
desc.en: A symbol carries 2 to 12 bits and denser grids fear noise more; phones change gear every millisecond as the signal fades.

title.zh: 多天线 MIMO 的容量

desc.zh: 多根天线把一条信道拆成几条并行的，容量随天线数而不是随功率涨。
desc.en: Several antennas split one channel into parallel ones, so capacity grows with the antenna count rather than the power.

zh: 路由器为什么有好几根天线

title.en: How close to the limit: fibre, 5G and 6G

desc.zh: 带日期和出处的前沿清单：哪些已确立、哪些已演示、哪些只是说法。
desc.en: A dated, sourced frontier list, separating what is established, what is demonstrated and what is only claimed.

title.en: Reading a spec sheet with the Shannon bound

desc.zh: 给出带宽、天线流数和信噪比，就能检查一个“最高速率”是否可能。
desc.en: Given bandwidth, streams and signal-to-noise ratio, check whether an advertised peak rate is even possible.
